selected_evidence.summary: Both files retained identical SHA-256 hashes before repair, after repair, and after reboot.
All paths are owned by inventorysvc:inventory-readers; directories are 0750, files are 0640, owner/group reads pass, and unrelated-user access is denied.

Captured healthy pre-restart state, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID from 242af11e-49fb-4e07-a001-8016b2349acb to 50002030-236c-42cc-b17f-29a3b38a1d1b, running system state, and recovered permissions, identities, data hashes, and access behavior.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- OS/KERNEL ---'
. /etc/os-release
printf 'ID=%s VERSION_ID=%s PRETTY_NAME=%s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID" "$PRETTY_NAME"
uname -r
printf '%s\n' '--- IDENTITIES ---'
getent passwd inventorysvc || true
getent group inventory-readers || true
printf '%s\n' '--- MOUNT/ROOT METADATA ---'
findmnt -T /srv/inventory -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS -n || true
stat -c 'path=%n type=%F owner=%U(%u) group=%G(%g) mode=%a size=%s' /srv/inventory
printf '%s\n' '--- TREE METADATA ---'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -printf '%y %m %u:%g %s %p\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- ACLS ---'
if command -v getfacl >/dev/null 2>&1; then getfacl -R -p /srv/inventory; else printf '%s\n' 'getfacl unavailable'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- CONTENT DIGESTS ---'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -exec sha256sum {} + | sort

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent group inventory-readers >/dev/null 2>&1; then groupadd --system inventory-readers; fi
if ! getent passwd inventorysvc >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd --system --gid inventory-readers --home-dir /nonexistent --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventorysvc; fi
chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
chmod -R u=rwX,g=rX,o= /srv/inventory
printf '%s\n' 'permission repair applied'
getent passwd inventorysvc
getent group inventory-readers

set -eu
printf '%s\n' '--- FINAL TREE ---'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -printf '%y %m %u:%g %s %p\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- ACL INDICATORS ---'
ls -ld /srv/inventory /srv/inventory/data /srv/inventory/data/config.json /srv/inventory/data/records.csv
printf '%s\n' '--- CONTENT DIGESTS ---'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -exec sha256sum {} + | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- ACCESS TESTS ---'
setpriv --reuid=inventorysvc --regid=inventory-readers --clear-groups -- sh -c 'test -r /srv/inventory/data/config.json && test -r /srv/inventory/data/records.csv'
printf '%s\n' 'owner_read=PASS'
setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=inventory-readers --clear-groups -- sh -c 'test -r /srv/inventory/data/config.json && test -r /srv/inventory/data/records.csv'
printf '%s\n' 'reader_group_read=PASS'
if setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups -- sh -c 'test -x /srv/inventory || test -r /srv/inventory/data/config.json'; then printf '%s\n' 'other_access=FAIL'; exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'other_access=DENIED'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- OS/KERNEL UNCHANGED ---'
. /etc/os-release
printf 'ID=%s VERSION_ID=%s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
uname -r

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'restart_ack node=%s boot_id_before=' "$NODE_NAME"
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
nohup sh -c 'sleep 2; systemctl reboot' >/tmp/inventory-restart.log 2>&1 </dev/null &
printf 'restart_scheduled pid=%s\n' "$!"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running || true

set -eu
old_boot_id=242af11e-49fb-4e07-a001-8016b2349acb
new_boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
printf 'boot_id_before=%s\nboot_id_after=%s\n' "$old_boot_id" "$new_boot_id"
[ "$new_boot_id" != "$old_boot_id" ]
printf '%s\n' 'boot_identity_changed=PASS'
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf '%s\n' '--- REQUIRED STATE AFTER RESTART ---'
getent passwd inventorysvc
getent group inventory-readers
find /srv/inventory -xdev -printf '%y %m %u:%g %s %p\n' | sort
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -exec sha256sum {} + | sort
setpriv --reuid=inventorysvc --regid=inventory-readers --clear-groups -- sh -c 'test -r /srv/inventory/data/config.json && test -r /srv/inventory/data/records.csv'
printf '%s\n' 'owner_read_after_restart=PASS'
setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=inventory-readers --clear-groups -- sh -c 'test -r /srv/inventory/data/config.json && test -r /srv/inventory/data/records.csv'
printf '%s\n' 'reader_group_read_after_restart=PASS'

. /etc/os-release

printf 'kernel='; uname -r
